mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings produced since 2024: thrust mains reported to slip onto the main cap and block side groove too easily rather than being an interference fit, with a spun-thrust risk. The thread reports a King technician confirming a free-spread spec problem on 2024 bearings.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.
